title: Hearty Earthy Vietnamese Red Snapper Bun Bo Hue
description: A one-pot Vietnamese dish featuring red snapper, nuka-pickle, and earthy flavors, made Whole30-friendly, in the style of Bun Bo Hue. This dish combines crunchy and earthy elements for a unique taste experience.

ingredients.name: fish sauce
ingredients.notes: make sure it is Whole30 compliant

instructions: In a large pot, heat 2 tablespoons of coconut oil over medium heat.
Add the bruised lemongrass and sliced ginger to the pot and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the chili flakes and cook for another minute, stirring constantly.
Add the red snapper fillets to the pot, skin side up, and cook for 3-4 minutes, until the skin is crispy.
Flip the fish over and cook for another 3-4 minutes, until cooked through.
Add the nuka-pickle, coconut aminos, fish sauce, and lime juice to the pot, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 5 minutes, until the flavors have melded together.
Stir in the bean sprouts and cook for an additional 2 minutes, until they are slightly tender.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Serve the dish hot, garnished with chopped scallions.
